name: setup-wizard-3-step-scan
title: Step 1 — Source Documents
description: Source documents hold files, as in prod: upload, name, download and delete, with each file scanned on its own and its state in the Library. The step panel holds the console (Scan or Resume, Pause, Restart, the page in view of the file's count, and the speed) and a scrubber of every page. The Library and Aldo fold into rails. The PDF renders live under a pinned page toolbar: select (Shift adds), mark, edit ID and name, delete, split, merge, continue onto the next page, hide Aldo's boxes, follow the scan, zoom, undo and redo. The run stops after its first three commitments so the person can check each one's ID, name and text, then reads the rest. What waits on the person is listed under Aldo's log as Needs you until answered; questions are answered, not obeyed; and the person can mark every commitment by hand instead. Every steer and edit is kept with the page it came on.

sections.label: Step header and console
sections.html: 101110

guide.intent: One panel: the step's numeral, title and prod's description; under a gray rule, the console for the file in view: a sunken tray across the panel, as steps 2 and 3 carry theirs, with Prev at its left end and Next at its right (a page each, as [ and ] are), and centered between them the transport (Scan or Resume, Pause, Restart), each a neutral key with its icon and name, the page in view of the file's page count as one field (type a page to go to it), and the speed (One at a time, Slow, Fast) in a menu. Nothing beside the console says where the run is: the console's pressed key, the page field and the strip show it. When the run is paused partway, one button sits beside it: Review the N so far, with its one action when it has one (Review the 12 so far). Below, every page of the file in one strip.
decisions: Each key is live only when it can act, and the run's state reads as a pressed key: Scan before the run, Resume when it is paused or stopped for the check, Pause while it reads, Restart once it has begun. Restart asks first and clears the file's scan and steers.
Speed is how fast the job dispatches page windows: a real control in prod. Every speed change, pause and resume is recorded as a steer.
With a source (not a file) selected, the console is dimmed and inert.
Prev is off on the first page and Next on the last.
acceptance: At the check after the first three commitments, Resume goes on past it at the speed chosen.
Type 140 in the page field and press Enter: the page and the scrubber's thumb move to p. 140.
Fold the Library and Aldo from their headers: each becomes a rail and the page takes the width; a rail opens it again.

sections.label: Scrubber
sections.html: 101110

guide.intent: Every page of the file, fifty at a time, with chevrons centered on the pages to page the window and small page guides under them. Unread pages are light gray; read pages take the Source Documents color, each find a white mark on every page it runs across: a dot where the find is whole on the page, the top half of the dot on the page where it opens, the bottom half on the page where it closes, and a bare ring on a page it runs through. A mark is dim until its find is parsed. Pages outside the scope are blank. The scan head is Aldo green. Hovering a page shows a small dark popover: its number, whether it is read, and what was found on it. Clicking the head cell takes up following the scan again.
decisions: All pages, not only those holding commitments: the person sees where the scope sits in the whole document.
No page or range label here: the header's status line carries it once.

At most three marks a page, in reading order: one closing first, then one running through, then whole ones, then one opening. Any mark lands on its find; the popover names it and its page range ("opens, pp. 131–132").
Steps 2 and 3 carry the same strip: the same cells, the same four colors (light gray undecided, darker gray wants a look, the step's color done, blank out of scope) and the same marks.
acceptance: On the ITP, page the window forward: the pages past Condition 11 read as out of scope.

sections.label: Library
sections.html: Library

guide.intent: The Library (the page is already Source Documents), dense at 13px with 12px states, folding into a rail from its header. Prod's model: a source document (name, reference number) holds files, and each file is scanned on its own. Each source folds open or shut by its chevron, and is its name, with a menu (Edit details, Add files, Delete source document); its files sit under it, one row each with the name (middle-truncated so the version and date stay) and one state: Not scanned, Reading p. 16 of 170 with a progress bar, a warning badge "3 to check", Paused at p. 40, 157 commitments, No commitments. A file's menu downloads it, restarts its scan or deletes it. New source document is pinned at the foot.
decisions: SetupWizardSourceDto and SetupWizardSourceFileDto as they are: source fields plus files with PageCount and CommitmentCount. The per-file scan state is new.
Every run keeps going while another file is in view.

Each file's state is a badge under its name: Not scanned (gray), Scanning (blue, with a progress bar), Paused at p. N (gray), 157 commitments (green), No commitments (gray). Beside it, one badge for what waits on that file: "3 to check" at the check, otherwise "N to settle" (its Open items list). A scanned file reads "Reading page images, p. N of M" with a progress bar while OCR runs.
Deletes ask first through a confirm dialog that states the impact (DeletionImpactGet): how many files and commitments go with it.
acceptance: New source document: name "Biological Opinion", reference "WCRO-2025-00123", add a PDF: the source is created and selected, and its file reads Not scanned.
Delete it from its details: the confirm reads "This deletes 1 file." and the source is gone after Delete source document.

sections.label: Source details
sections.html:
Files

    No files yet.

    Delete source document

    Deleting it removes its files and every commitment found in them. This cannot be undone.

guide.intent: Selecting a source (not one of its files) shows prod's source view in the main pane: Name and Reference number with Save, the files with page count and scan state (Open scan, Download, Delete), the upload dropzone for more PDFs, and Delete source document in a danger zone.
decisions: Feature parity with prod's source step: upload, name, delete and download (sourceDocumentsPut, source file Post, Delete, DownloadGet).
Uploads in the prototype are kept in the browser (IndexedDB) and render for real; they have no scan, and Aldo says so.
acceptance: Select Final Environmental Impact Report: its two files list with "170 pages. Not scanned." and "4 pages. Not scanned."

sections.label: Page and boxes

guide.intent: The page in view, rendered from the PDF by pdf.js, with a box per commitment: dashed where Aldo drew it, solid where a person did, under a toolbar pinned across the pane. Select (V) and Mark (M) are the modes; Edit ID and name (Enter) and Delete act on the selection; More tools holds Split (S), Merge, Continue on next page and Hide Aldo's boxes (B); then Follow (F), zoom and Undo / Redo. A selected box wears its ID and name; eight handles resize it, a drag moves it, arrows nudge (Shift for a bigger step), Shift+click adds another box to the selection, Escape lets go. Every edit and undo is recorded as a steer with its page. Requirement spans are not drawn in step 1: they are step 2's.
decisions: Boxes are PdfBoundingBoxDto (page, x, y, width, height as page fractions); an edit sends the new rect for that commitment and page.
Boxes come from anchoring against the text layer (PdfPig words), not from model citations.
Manual work never pauses the run; it stops the view following the scan, and Follow brings it back.
The bar never changes shape: a tool that needs a selection sits in place, off until there is one. Nothing floats over the text the person is reading.

Mark asks for a targeted re-read of the region. Split cuts a box at a height: the top keeps the commitment, the bottom becomes a passage of its own. Merge keeps the first ID in reading order and takes every box. Continue on next page adds a box on the next page to the same commitment (PdfBoundingBoxDto already allows many pages).
Undo puts the record of finds back; the conversation stays append-only, so an undo is itself a steer ("Undid: ...").
gotchas: Assign table words to rows by y with a few points of slack: a cell's first line can sit a hundredth of a point above the row's code.
A flattened form (the NOD) has drawn labels and image text; the text layer misses them, so the page needs OCR or a vision pass.
acceptance: Mark, then drag over a passage: a solid box appears selected, wearing No ID; Delete removes it, and both edits are in the conversation.
Select 11.1 and 11.2 (Shift+click), More tools, Merge: one commitment, 11.1, with both boxes; Cmd+Z puts them back, and "Undid: Merged 11.2 into COA 11.1" is in the conversation.
Select a box, Split (S), click across its middle: the box ends there and the lower part is a new passage.
Drag a box's corner handle: the box resizes and Aldo records "Adjusted".

sections.label: Aldo
sections.html:
Aldo

  1. Aldo

    I read the contents and headings of the ITP. The commitments are in VIII. Conditions of Approval, : about 293. Condition 11, Take Minimization Measures, holds 158 of them on , in three parts: Multi-Species, Construction Phase, and Operations Phases. Tell me where to start, or scan Condition 11.

    p. 131

    Drop to attach

      Instructions in effect

guide.intent: The conversation that scopes, checks and steers the scan of the file in view, dense at 13px, with the composer always in view. The run's status is not here: it sits by the scan's controls. The run stops after its first three commitments; Aldo says what to check, then gives each commitment its own message: a lead (where it took the ID and name from, how far the text runs) and a card with the ID, name and quoted text (clamped, with Show all), a p. N button, Looks right and Fix. Fix opens the ID, name and text as fields, with Save and Redraw the box. Edit ID and name on the page toolbar opens the same fields for any commitment in a side panel, not in the conversation; Save is recorded there as an event line. Requirements, timing and parties are reviewed in step 2.
decisions: Open items: what waits on the person is listed with its answers until answered, behind an indicator in the panel's header (a count and "open items", or "Instructions (n)" when nothing waits) that opens it as a tray over the log; the indicator nods when a new item arrives and never opens on its own. Expanded on a wide window (1440 and up) the list is a sidebar beside the conversation instead (items: the check, a flagged reference with Dismiss / Keep it / Skip all cross-references, a headless passage with Merge / Keep separate, pages with nothing found with Mark on p. N / Nothing there, a drawn box with no ID). The log keeps the notice text; the buttons live only in the list.

Confirming the last commitment of the check (Looks right, All look right, or saying so) goes on reading, Fast, or One at a time if that was chosen; the speed menu changes it. Before the check, the status reads "Stopping after 3 commitments for your check", never a pause.
A question is answered and changes nothing; a message too short to act on gets its readings as buttons. Prod's structured call needs answer and unclear kinds.
Instructions in effect, collapsed under the log with a count: the scope, each rule with the page it took effect from, each fix from the check.
A scanned file (no text layer) shows Reading page images, p. N of M in its row, the status and Aldo's opening until OCR is done; nothing else starts before it.
A check card is the ID, the name and the text, stacked. Timing, parties and the MMRP's columns are step 2's, not the card's.
A paused run offers Review the N so far.
Mark them myself (on the opening): the person draws each commitment; Aldo names what is inside each box. Status: "By hand. N marked."
The check is the training step: what the person fixes there becomes an instruction for the rest of the file.

Buttons carry meaning in their color: green to accept, red to remove (Dismiss), blue to change the record (Merge, Re-read), the primary for the next step, neutral otherwise. Only send is Aldo's green.
A name fixed at the check is the commitment's name in step 2.
One structured-output call per message returns actions and a one-line reply; sw3-steer.ts is the schema, with a pattern matcher standing in for the model.
Each file keeps its own conversation; switching files switches the thread.

The composer carries what rides along as chips above the field: the page in view and the selected commitment attach themselves (dashed, removable; a removed one stays off until the person moves), @ adds a commitment from a menu that filters as you type and writes its ID into the sentence, and a file is attached with the paperclip or dropped on the composer. Aldo reads a file as context for this document, never as a source of commitments. A sent message shows its chips under it; pressing one opens what it names.
/ at the start of the field lists the commands (scope, skip, rule, reread, why, pause, resume); each puts the start of a message in the field to finish.

A reply comes in as it is written: three dots, then the words. While it does, send is Stop; Stop ends the reply where it is and marks it Stopped (in prod it cancels the call). The latest messages have hover keys beside Copy: Edit on the person's (takes the message back, and what it did, and puts it in the field with its chips) and Retry on Aldo's (asks again).

Expand (beside the fold chevron) lays the conversation over the right of the window, under the top bar and over the help bar, for when talking to Aldo is the work: about half the window, or 60% with the Open items sidebar on a wide window (the sidebar folds away when nothing is open). Nothing under it moves. Any press that changes the record or opens something (an answer to an open item, Looks right, a page or commitment reference, a chip) docks it, so the person sees what happened. Dock, Esc or a click anywhere off the panel docks it too, mid-sentence drafts included (Esc closes an open tray first).

A button pressed in the conversation (Looks right, Keep it, Dismiss, an answer to an open item) is recorded as a steer too, but shows as a quiet centered line saying what it did ("Confirmed COA 11.2"), never as a message the person wrote, and Aldo does not echo it; the card shows its new state. The time is in the line's tooltip.

The scan's controls (Scan, Pause, Resume, speed) are recorded as steers, so the model sees a person slow it down, but the conversation shows each as one quiet centered line ("Set the speed to Fast on p. 132 at 7:14 PM"), with no bubble and no reply; only Scan gets Aldo's answer.
acceptance: At the check, Open items reads "Check the first 3: 3 left." All look right, then Read the rest: the run goes on at Fast.
When the run is done: Open items lists COA 11.32, the top of p. 156 and pp. 152 to 154; Keep it on 11.32 and Merge on p. 156 leave one, and the Library row reads "1 to settle."
Type "why did you flag 11.32?": Aldo explains and the instructions are unchanged.
On the MMRP, Mark them myself, then drag over MM AES-1a: Aldo reads it as MM AES-1a and the status reads "By hand. 1 marked."
Fix COA 11.1, change its name, Save: the card reads Fixed, and step 2 shows the new name.
Looks right on the other two, then Resume: the run goes on.
Reload: every file's conversation and run are where they were.

Type half a message, Expand: the panel takes the right of the window with the draft in it; press p. 146 in a message: the page beside it moves to p. 146; Esc: the panel is docked again with the draft.
